points.description: States that the mangrove would die or not grow well in freshwater, AND explains why: it needs saltwater / freshwater (no salt) is outside its range of tolerance for salt. Equivalent wording accepted.

levels.says: Says the mangrove would die or not grow well, but gives no reason (or an incorrect reason).

rubric.notes: Full mark: predicts death/poor growth and explains it by the tree needing salt / freshwater being outside its salt tolerance range. Half: correct prediction with no or wrong explanation. Zero: predicts the tree thrives or is unaffected.
